item.title: LOT-106: reader display settings (message style, signatures, swipe pages)
item.body:
LOT-106
Closes #197
Claim: cloud/lot-106

**Problem.** The reader had no settings: layout (`theme_style`), signatures (`display_sig`) and page swipe (`topic_page_swipe_navigation`) existed in legacy only. Text size is LOT-169's, not touched here.

**Cause.** LOT-083 left `showsSignatures` as an option with no UI; no layout option, no swipe, no key for the swipe.

**Change** (spec: `docs/lots/LOT-106-reader-display-settings.md`)
- HFRStorage: `SettingKey.topicPageSwipe` (`topic_page_swipe_navigation`, default on).
- "Sujets" section in Réglages (`TopicsSettingsModel`): Style des messages, Afficher les signatures, Swipe changement de page; legacy keys and shapes.
- Reader: `ReaderRenderOptions.style` → `style-classic`/`style-modern` body class + CSS; `TopicReaderModel.applyDisplaySettings()` rebuilds the shown page on a settings change (no request, scroll kept), triggered by `UserDefaults.didChangeNotification`; `PageSwipe` (legacy 120/70/0.5 rule) + `swipe(_:)`.
- Wider than that: nothing. Me/love header variants and text-selection guard are listed as differences in the spec.

**Tests.** `ReaderDisplaySettingsTests` (style class, live rebuild only on change, no request, swipe rule and page bounds), `TopicsSettingsModelTests` (defaults, stored legacy values, written keys), `SettingKeyTests` (new key). Not shown failing locally (app cannot be built in the cloud); CI is the arbiter.

**Mac check needed** (`mac/m2-lead`, iPhone 18 Pro + iPad, light/dark, Dynamic Type XL)
- [ ] Réglages › Sujets: three rows present, values persist after relaunch.
- [ ] Switching Style des messages with a reader open changes the header tint/padding at once, without reload or scroll jump.
- [ ] Signatures on/off applies to the open reader.
- [ ] Swipe left → next page from top; swipe right → previous page at its last message; off → no page change; no conflict with vertical scroll, link taps, spoilers, text selection.
- [ ] Classic vs modern look acceptable against the legacy app (header tint colours are approximations).

** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Reject swipes until the new document is ready.** After a page request succeeds, `finish` sets `page` and clears `isLoading`, but `ReaderWebController` loads the replacement document afterward. If the user swipes the still-visible old page during that interval, this guard accepts the swipe and calculates another destination from the new page. The reader can skip a page. Require `readyToken == document?.token` before accepting a swipe. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ezzz/HFRnow/2a2335178ac892e59bf227e30b8b1e8c60630640/App/SwiftHFR/Reader/ReaderWebController.swift))

Script executed: ```bash # Read the full reader view with line numbers. cat -n App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicReaderView.swift # Locate the display-settings application and the swipe setting reads. rg -n -F -- 'applyDisplaySettings' App/SwiftHFR || test "$?" -eq 1 rg -n -F -- 'swipesPages' App/SwiftHFR || test "$?" -eq 1 rg -n -F -- 'didChangeNotification' App/SwiftHFR || test "$?" -eq 1 ``` Repository: ezzz/HFRnow Length of output: 12211 --- Script executed: ```bash # Read the model file, which owns applyDisplaySettings() and onAppear(). cat -n App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicReaderModel.swift ``` Repository: ezzz/HFRnow Length of output: 17551 ---
**Apply display settings when the reader task starts.** The reader applies display settings only when a notification arrives while its task runs. If the task is cancelled, for example when the reader leaves the screen, a settings change made in the meantime is not applied on return. `onAppear()` also returns early for a reader that already shows a page (`TopicReaderModel.swift:108`), so nothing rebuilds the document. Style and signatures can stay stale until the next settings notification or a refresh. Call `applyDisplaySettings()` right after the initial settings read. The method returns early when nothing changed, so the extra call is cheap.
Suggested fix

```diff --- "a/App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicReaderView.swift" +++ "b/App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicReaderView.swift" @@ -59,8 +59,9 @@ .onAppear(perform: makeController) .task { // The settings screen writes `UserDefaults`: a display setting changed there reaches the open reader at once. swipeEnabled = services.settings.swipesPages() + model.applyDisplaySettings() for await _ in NotificationCenter.default.notifications(named: UserDefaults.didChangeNotification) { swipeEnabled = services.settings.swipesPages() model.applyDisplaySettings() } ```

> **IMPORTANT** > Review the replacement and indentation, then test before committing. ```suggestion swipeEnabled = services.settings.swipesPages() model.applyDisplaySettings() ```
